name: Akasztó (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Akasztó (a blue shield with a yellow sheaf of grain, with a helm and red and white mantling) above the name AKASZTÓ in grey.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Akasztó arms with helm and mantling
